limitations: All scores are provisional browser evaluations based on the supplied screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and runtime narrative; I did not execute tests or inspect a video.
Corresponding transition, normal and enlarged captures are grouped with each named screen state; visually identical variants are assessed together.
Browser scores use the full numeric range without deductions solely for deferred physical or native verification.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, haptics, tilt, actual OS sharing, native notifications and native performance remain unverified and cannot receive full/native 9–10 certification.
The supplied browser runtime reports contrast, keyboard, focus, reduced motion, persistence, recovery and timing checks; screenshots alone do not establish those behaviors.
Filmstrips demonstrate sampled continuity, not frame rate or convincing independent parallax; performance claims rely on the separately supplied runtime measurements.
Synthetic forecast, repeated stress content and labeled fixture wording were not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Connected Circles, real billing and real native sharing are not demonstrated; their explicitly disclosed browser fallback states were evaluated on their own merits.
Below-viewport content was not classified as inaccessible merely because it is cropped in a screenshot when the supplied browser evidence reports successful scrolling and retrieval.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; the authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is nevertheless unmet by multiple screens and components.

For each item, A is the mean of its applicable hierarchy, typography and surfaces scores, F is the mean of its applicable clarity, feedback and accessibility scores, and overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1).
topFixes: Improve physical anchoring: localize shadows, support parchment against room features, soften table cut edges and remove the golden orb’s residual disk-like halo.
Reduce enlarged vertical burden through shorter utility copy and tighter centered grouping, especially context disclosure, check-in, birth errors, plans and invitation results.
Make long centered explanations easier to track with clearer section landmarks and shorter visual passage groups while preserving complete text.
Refine the plan ledger’s selected-row boundary and spacing so benefits, price, terms and commitment form one clear sequence.
Strengthen continuation cues in constrained name forms and long input fields without letting scroll badges overlap clipped letterforms.
Supply browser evidence for room-destination focus/targets and reading-pack/restore results, where the provided coverage is less specific.
